rows.inputs: the Trait Descriptive Adjectives census list (Condon, Coughlin and Weston 2022); source_ref prefix tda:
rows.exclusion_rule: a corpus trait whose file's `source` names the TDA list, or a corpus trait whose seed-queue entry carries `source:censuses` (or a `gap_registry_key`), or a renamed_from of one

rows.inputs: Allport and Odbert's 1936 word list as digitised on OSF; source_ref prefix allport:
rows.exclusion_rule: a corpus trait whose file's `source` names Allport and Odbert's list (not Allport and Ross's religious orientation scale, which extrinsic_allport and intrinsic_allport name), or a corpus trait whose seed-queue entry carries `source:censuses` (or a `gap_registry_key`), or a renamed_from of one

rows.inputs: Roget's Thesaurus heads chosen as the gap heads of the coverage report, which is built from corpus labels (roget/harvest.py select_heads); the harvest within a head is independent
rows.exclusion_rule: a corpus trait whose file's `source` names Roget, or a corpus trait whose seed-queue entry carries `source:roget` (or a `gap_registry_key`), or a renamed_from of one
rows.note: no `recover` command: generator-side hiding not built

rows.inputs: WordNet's (OEWN) trait-noun closure: adjectives under the trait synsets (no partner_hint)
rows.exclusion_rule: a corpus trait whose file's `source` names OEWN or WordNet, or a corpus trait whose seed-queue entry carries `source:wn_clusters` (or a `gap_registry_key`), or a renamed_from of one

rows.inputs: WordNet antonyms of corpus labels with no partner file (partner_hint set)
rows.exclusion_rule: a corpus trait whose queue entry carries `source:wn_clusters`, or whose file's `source` names OEWN

rows.inputs: the International Personality Item Pool's items, clustered and named blind (no corpus label shown)
rows.exclusion_rule: a corpus trait whose file's `source` names the IPIP, or a corpus trait whose seed-queue entry carries `source:ipip` (or a `gap_registry_key`), or a renamed_from of one

rows.inputs: a base model's continuations of list and gloss frames (base_model/prompts.py names no corpus trait)
rows.exclusion_rule: a corpus trait whose seed-queue entry carries `source:base_model` (or a `gap_registry_key`), or a renamed_from of one

rows.inputs: a masked language model's fills of trait frames (no run submitted yet)
rows.exclusion_rule: a corpus trait whose seed-queue entry carries `source:masked_lm` (or a `gap_registry_key`), or a renamed_from of one

rows.inputs: AI-disposition phrases extracted from alignment papers, incident lists and usage policies
rows.exclusion_rule: a corpus trait whose seed-queue entry carries `source:alignment_sweep` (or a `gap_registry_key`), or a renamed_from of one
rows.note: its occasions are its own runs (the papers run and variant B), tested on their own

rows.inputs: the antonym check's candidate antonyms of corpus traits (generate_antonyms.py answers)
rows.exclusion_rule: a corpus trait whose seed-queue entry carries `source:antonym_check` (or a `gap_registry_key`), or a renamed_from of one

rows.inputs: plan 09's structural operators over corpus arrangements (not built)
rows.exclusion_rule: a corpus trait whose seed-queue entry carries `source:structural` (or a `gap_registry_key`), or a renamed_from of one

rows.inputs: names the states pass proposed for rows M1 held as states; source_ref is the source row's key
rows.exclusion_rule: attributed to the source row's generator (pre-registered question 6)

rows.inputs: re-judges rows on the physical holding list; submits no row of its own
rows.exclusion_rule: attributed to the row's own generators

rows.inputs: the M1 validation pool (corpus labels and known non-traits)
words Roger sent to the pipeline by hand (W23)
plan 13's paraphrase sanity set (a scratch registry only)
rows.exclusion_rule: a test set, not a generator
